# Weft 1.1.30
- The sidebar bell opens pending actions only, with clear red badges on the notification control, affected projects and checkouts, and the Dock icon. Reports and routine activity stay in Operator. - Reading notifications leaves action badges visible until a decision is made. Full-width review rows show the affected project and checkout. - Fixed the false setup block on recovered checkout approvals when no file-copy rules exist. Approval failures appear inside the review. - The Dock badge refreshes after launch and activation, with system badge permission requested alongside notification alerts.
